## Section 6: A first analysis

```{r}
#| label: analysis
data(mtcars)
summary(mtcars[, c("mpg", "wt")])

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x) +
  labs(x = "Weight (1000 lbs)", y = "Miles per gallon")

tidy(lm(mpg ~ wt, data = mtcars))
```

- [ ] The data loaded and the summary printed
- [ ] The plot rendered
- [ ] The model ran and printed its results

**Reflection question 6:** Describe the relationship between vehicle weight and fuel efficiency in the plot. What does the model suggest?
